{{Top|leg}}
The '''''Protector''''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. While en route to the detention facility on [[Dles IV]], the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] prisoner [[Nakaron]] managed to break free and hijack the shuttle, capturing the crew and [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Thom Clessigan]]. Three months later, Nakaron issued demands regarding the release of the hostages; the New Republic prepared to solve the matter with an independent strike team.<ref name="AJ1">{{JournalCite|1|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}</ref>
